credentialsLoginExited: Antigravity exited. Close this dialog and start the sign-in again.

credentialsLoginIntro: Complete the Google sign-in in the terminal below, then press Done. Antigravity keeps the account in the OS keyring, so the account is shared by all Antigravity sessions and every official Antigravity provider row.
